title: Tomorrow
summary: Talk about tomorrow and the day after with سَـ and سَوْفَ, ask people about their plans, and say that you are busy.
intro: Week 8 is about plans and the future. The future is easy in Arabic: put سَـ (sa-) in front of a present verb. أَزُورُ means 'I visit', and سَأَزُورُ means 'I will visit'. The longer word سَوْفَ does the same job: سَوْفَ أَتَّصِلُ (I will call). Today you also learn غَدًا (tomorrow) and بَعْدَ غَدٍ (the day after tomorrow).
objectives: Say three things you will do tomorrow with سَـ
Ask a friend about their plans: مَاذَا سَتَفْعَلُ غَدًا؟
Use غَدًا and بَعْدَ غَدٍ to say when
Say that you are busy: أَنَا مَشْغُول or أَنَا مَشْغُولَة

realLife.title: The last class of the week
realLife.story: It is Thursday afternoon, the last class before the weekend. Mr Karim asks everyone about their plans, and he cannot believe that Daniel has been in Cairo for two months and still hasn't seen the pyramids. Luckily Sami already has a plan.

sentences.en: I will visit the pyramids the day after tomorrow.

mistakes.why: sawfa and sa- go with the present form (azūru), never with the past (zurtu).

sentences.en: What will you do tomorrow? (to a man)

mistakes.why: faʿalta is the past ('you did'). For tomorrow use sa- + the present: sa-tafʿalu.

sentences.en: I will call my sister in the evening.
sentences.literal: will I-call with-my-sister in the evening

sentences.ar: لَيْلَى مَشْغُولَة غَدًا، سَتُقَابِلُ بِنْتَ خَالَتِهَا.
sentences.en: Layla is busy tomorrow: she will meet her cousin.
sentences.literal: Layla busy tomorrow, she-will-meet daughter-of her-aunt

mistakes.why: Layla is a woman, so the adjective takes ة: mashghūla.

sentences.ar: عِنْدِي مَوْعِد مَعَ الطَّبِيبَة يَوْمَ الثُّلَاثَاء.
sentences.en: I have an appointment with the doctor on Tuesday.
sentences.literal: at-me appointment with the doctor (f) day-of Tuesday

dialogue.title: Plans for tomorrow
dialogue.culture: In Egypt the weekend is Friday and Saturday, and Sunday is a normal working day. Friday is the day for the midday prayer and for big family lunches, often at the grandparents' house. When Arabs talk about plans, they usually add إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰه (God willing): nobody knows the future for sure.

lines.ar: هٰذَا آخِرُ دَرْس فِي الْأُسْبُوع يَا شَبَاب. غَدًا يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَة، فَمَاذَا سَتَفْعَلُونَ؟
lines.en: This is the last lesson of the week, everyone. Tomorrow is Friday, so what are you going to do?

lines.ar: غَدًا سَأَنَامُ حَتَّى السَّاعَة التَّاسِعَة، وَفِي الْمَسَاء سَأَتَّصِلُ بِعَائِلَتِي فِي شِيكَاغُو.
lines.en: Tomorrow I'll sleep until nine o'clock, and in the evening I'll call my family in Chicago.
segs: I will call, I will phone

lines.ar: فِكْرَة جَيِّدَة! وَأَنْتِ يَا لَيْلَى؟ هَلْ عِنْدَكِ خُطَّة لِلْغَد؟
lines.en: That's a good idea! And you, Layla? Do you have a plan for tomorrow?

lines.ar: نَعَم، أَنَا مَشْغُولَة جِدًّا غَدًا. سَأُنَظِّفُ شَقَّتِي فِي الصَّبَاح، ثُمَّ سَأُقَابِلُ بِنْتَ خَالَتِي.
lines.en: Yes, I'm very busy tomorrow. I'll clean my flat in the morning, then I'll meet my cousin.

lines.ar: وَأَنَا سَأَزُورُ جَدَّتِي مَعَ أَبِي وَأُمِّي، فَهِيَ تَطْبُخُ لَنَا كُلَّ يَوْمِ جُمُعَة.
lines.en: And I'll visit my grandmother with my father and mother; she cooks for us every Friday.

lines.ar: جَمِيل! وَبَعْدَ غَدٍ يَوْمُ السَّبْت. مَتَى سَتُرَاجِعُونَ الدُّرُوس؟ يَوْمَ الْأَحَد عِنْدَنَا اِمْتِحَان قَصِير.
lines.en: Lovely! And the day after tomorrow is Saturday. When will you revise the lessons? On Sunday we have a short test.

lines.ar: سَأُرَاجِعُ الدُّرُوس غَدًا بَعْدَ الظُّهْر، لِأَنَّنِي سَأَكُونُ مَشْغُولًا يَوْمَ السَّبْت.
lines.en: I'll revise the lessons tomorrow afternoon, because I'll be busy all day on Saturday.

lines.ar: صَحِيح! بَعْدَ غَدٍ سَنَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْأَهْرَام مَعًا. دَانْيَال لَمْ يَرَ الْأَهْرَام بَعْدُ!
lines.en: That's right! The day after tomorrow we're going to the pyramids together. Daniel hasn't seen the pyramids yet!

lines.ar: مَعْقُول؟ أَنْتَ فِي الْقَاهِرَة مُنْذُ شَهْرَيْن، وَلَمْ تَرَ الْأَهْرَام؟
lines.en: Really? You've been in Cairo for two months, and you haven't seen the pyramids?
segs: you see (after lam, to a man)

lines.ar: لِلْأَسَف لَا. فِي الْبِدَايَة كُنْتُ مَشْغُولًا، ثُمَّ كُنْتُ مَرِيضًا. لٰكِنْ سَوْفَ أَرَاهَا يَوْمَ السَّبْت، إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰه!
lines.en: Sadly not. At first I was busy, and then I was ill. But I'll see them on Saturday, God willing!

lines.ar: سَتُحِبُّهَا كَثِيرًا! اِذْهَبَا مُبَكِّرًا، لِأَنَّ الْمَكَان سَيَكُونُ مُزْدَحِمًا لَاحِقًا.
lines.en: You'll love them! Go early, you two, because the place will be very crowded later.
segs: you will love them (to a man)

lines.ar: مَعَكِ حَقّ. سَنَخْرُجُ مِنَ الْبَيْت فِي السَّاعَة السَّابِعَة، وَسَنَرْكَبُ تَاكْسِي إِلَى الْجِيزَة.
lines.en: You're right. We'll leave the house at seven o'clock and take a taxi to Giza.
segs: we will go out, we will leave
and we will take (a taxi, a bus)
Giza (city next to Cairo, home of the pyramids)

lines.ar: إِذَنْ لَا تَنْسَوْا: اِمْتِحَان قَصِير يَوْمَ الْأَحَد، وَسَأَسْأَلُكُمْ عَنْ خُطَطِكُمْ أَيْضًا!
lines.en: Then don't forget: a short test on Sunday, and I'll ask you about your plans too!
segs: and I will ask you (to a group)

lines.ar: لَا مُشْكِلَة يَا أُسْتَاذ! سَنَتَكَلَّمُ عَنِ الْأَهْرَام بِالْعَرَبِيَّة طَبْعًا. إِلَى اللِّقَاء!
lines.en: No problem, teacher! We'll talk about the pyramids in Arabic, of course. See you on Sunday!

reading.title: Everyone's plans
reading.ar: غَدًا يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَة. سَيَنَامُ دَانْيَال حَتَّى السَّاعَة التَّاسِعَة، وَفِي الْمَسَاء سَيَتَّصِلُ بِعَائِلَتِهِ. لَيْلَى مَشْغُولَة: سَتُنَظِّفُ شَقَّتَهَا، ثُمَّ سَتُقَابِلُ بِنْتَ خَالَتِهَا. وَبَعْدَ غَدٍ سَيَزُورُ دَانْيَال وَسَامِي الْأَهْرَام. وَيَوْمَ الْأَحَد عِنْدَ الطُّلَّاب اِمْتِحَان قَصِير.
reading.en: Tomorrow is Friday. Daniel will sleep until nine o'clock, and in the evening he will call his family. Layla is busy: she will clean her flat, then she will meet her cousin. And the day after tomorrow Daniel and Sami will visit the pyramids. And on Sunday the students have a short test.

quiz.prompt: What will Daniel do tomorrow evening?
When will Daniel and Sami go to the pyramids?
Which sentence means 'I will visit my grandmother'?
Why is Daniel going to revise on Friday afternoon?
options: He has an appointment on Friday.
He will be busy on Saturday.

quiz.prompt: Which word begins with ghayn (غ), the soft gargle?

completion: Well done! You can now talk about tomorrow with سَـ and سَوْفَ, and ask your friends about their plans. Next: the weekend, and how to say what you won't do.
